newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar firm but in range, trading thin.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar firm but in range, trading thin.

text.p: White sugar futures held fast to earlier tight ranges on Thursday afternoon but the steadiness seen in New York raws ensured that London prices were gently firmer, traders said.
"It's not doing anything, there's no range," said one, adding that although New York was also rangebound the nearby prices were also holding their strength.
Traders said switch dealings appeared the main feature of a thin session, with October/May trading at $2.00. Volume reached 1,198 lots by 1535 GMT, boosted by a sprinkling of against actuals trades.
October was up 50 cents at $323.00 and December up by the same amount at $320.20. Trade and commission house players were cited as most prominent in the dull session.
Paris was also quiet although there was more movement in back months such as August 1998, up $2.00 at $320.00.
October was unchanged at $322.50 and December up 50 cents at $320.00. Matif volume amounted to 549 lots.
